skill: Solve homogeneous first-order ODEs using y=v(x)x, reduce to x v'=F(v)-v, separate and integrate, substitute back, and select one general solution from five mathematical choices.
reasoning_steps: Recognize or use degree-zero right-hand side F(y/x).
Substitute and cancel the v term; separate the resulting variables.
Integrate using elementary powers or logarithms at easy difficulty, absorb arbitrary constants, and replace v by y/x.
Distinguish the resulting solution from plausible incorrect integrations and substitutions.
response_contract: Observed questions use one radio field named selection with five math-valued choices. Easy source questions explicitly supply the substitution. No free-entry response is evidenced.
difficulty: Three explicitly easy questions: cubic-power cancellation with cube root; affine F(v)=1+2v; affine F(v)=1+v. Moderate questions add more elaborate rational cancellation, nested logarithms and arctangent. Canonical quadratic rational example has no difficulty label.
invariants: Homogeneous degree-zero first-order equation, x nonzero on an interval.
Substitution, separation, elementary integration and back-substitution remain the assessed operations.
Exactly one mathematically distinct correct solution in a five-choice radio bank.
Prompt, answer bank, worked solution and domains must describe the same equation.
permitted_variations: Change nonzero small coefficients and signs in the easy affine or cancellation families while preserving comparable integration workload.
Change the coefficient of v in affine F(v); this legitimately changes logarithmic versus power integration when crossing coefficient 1.
Change the coefficient of the surviving inverse-square term in the cubic family; derive the logarithm multiplier and root expression from it.
Vary candidate position, distractor errors and mathematically eligible solution shapes so recognizing a template or lone root does not suffice.
Power-degree variations near observed easy powers may be defensible same-method extensions, but demand workload and domain review; arbitrary new operators are not justified.
essential_vs_incidental: The substitution and homogeneous structure are essential. The source coefficients 1,2,3, a positive sign, a particular correct position, and a unique root-shaped candidate are incidental answer-bearing assignments. They need not remain fixed. The target is the general solution, not a freely variable requested quantity.
